nodes.label: ML-DSA-65 Module-Lattice Digital Signature Algorithm
nodes.description: NIST FIPS 204 Category 3 post-quantum digital signature mechanism parameter set based on Module Learning With Errors (M-LWE) and Module Short Integer Solution (M-SIS) hard problems.

nodes.label: Compute Express Link (CXL) 3.1 Fabric Manager (FM) Management API
nodes.description: Out-of-band and in-band management interface specification defining command sets for dynamic fabric re-binding, memory pooling, and physical switch topology management across CXL 3.1 domain controllers.

nodes.label: CAMeL Tools Named Entity Recognition (NER) Subsystem
nodes.description: Sequence labeling and feature-rich statistical/neural pipeline within CAMeL Tools extracting named entities (Person, Location, Organization) from Arabic text.

nodes.label: W3C OWL 2 QL Profile Specification
nodes.description: W3C Recommendation defining a profile of OWL 2 designed for applications with large numbers of instances where query answering is rewritten directly to standard SQL over relational databases.

nodes.label: GraphBLAS Fast-SV Connected Components Algorithm Kernel
nodes.description: Algebraic graph algorithm computing weakly connected components via linear algebra operations (Shiloach-Vishkin / FastSV variant) over GraphBLAS semirings.
